basic.name: Basic Info
basic.description: Core summary and identification details of the PE file.

magic.name: Magic
magic.description: The format indicator identifying the PE architecture variant (e.g., PE32 for 32-bit, PE32+ for 64-bit).

language.name: Language
language.description: The language detected from the resource directory or other structures in the file.

compiler.name: Compiler
compiler.description: The estimated compiler or build toolchain used to compile the executable.

entryPoint.name: Entry Point
entryPoint.description: The Relative Virtual Address (RVA) and file offset where execution of the program starts.

imageBase.name: Image Base
imageBase.description: The preferred memory address where the operating system attempts to load the executable.

machine.name: Machine
machine.description: The target CPU architecture specified in the PE header (e.g., x64, Intel 386).

timeDateStamp.name: Timestamp
timeDateStamp.description: The compilation date and time recorded by the compiler or linker.

impHash.name: Import Hash (ImpHash)
impHash.description: A hash calculated from the list and order of imported DLLs and functions, commonly used to group similar malware families.

entropy.name: Entropy
entropy.description: A measure of data randomness/complexity. Values close to 8 suggest the file is likely compressed, encrypted, or packed.

anomalies.name: Anomalies
anomalies.description: Suspicious elements or deviations from standard PE specification detected during analysis.

debugInfo.name: Debug Info
debugInfo.description: Metadata from the debug directory indicating how debugging information is stored.

pdbPath.name: PDB Path
pdbPath.description: The local path to the Program Database (.pdb) symbol file generated during compilation, which can reveal details of the development environment.

dosHeader.name: DOS Header
dosHeader.description: The legacy header present at the beginning of PE files for MS-DOS backwards compatibility.

lfanew.name: e_lfanew (PE Offset)
lfanew.description: The file offset indicating the starting position of the PE (NT) header.

richHeader.name: Rich Header
richHeader.description: An undocumented header present in files built with Microsoft Visual Studio containing compiler and build tool information.

fileHeader.name: File Header
fileHeader.description: Contains physical layout characteristics of the PE file (e.g., section count, machine type).

numberOfSections.name: Section Count
numberOfSections.description: The total number of sections defined in the PE file.

characteristics.name: Characteristics
characteristics.description: Flags specifying attributes of the executable (e.g., whether it is a DLL, system file, executable).

optionalHeader.name: Optional Header
optionalHeader.description: The header specifying detailed settings required by the operating system loader to map the executable into memory.

dataDirectories.name: Data Directories
dataDirectories.description: An array defining the location (RVA) and size of key data structures like imports, exports, resources, and certificates.

sections.name: Sections
sections.description: Logical subdivisions of the PE file containing actual code, data, resources, etc.

sectionName.name: Name
sectionName.description: The name of the section (.text, .data, .rsrc, etc.).

virtualSize.name: Virtual Size
virtualSize.description: The actual size of the section when loaded into memory.

virtualAddress.name: Virtual Address
virtualAddress.description: The Relative Virtual Address (RVA) of the section start in memory.

rawSize.name: Raw Size
rawSize.description: The size of the section's initialized data on disk.

pointerToRawData.name: Raw Pointer
pointerToRawData.description: The file offset pointing to the start of the section data on disk.

imports.name: Imports
imports.description: The list of functions and libraries imported from external DLLs to support program execution.

library.name: Library
library.description: The name of the Dynamic Link Library (DLL) containing the imported function.

exports.name: Exports
exports.description: The list of functions made publicly available by this executable (mostly DLLs) to be called by other programs.

ordinal.name: Ordinal
ordinal.description: The unique numerical identifier assigned to an exported function, which can be used to load it instead of the name.

address.name: Address
address.description: The actual virtual address or relative virtual address (RVA) of the exported function.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: The byte offset where the item starts in the file.

security.name: Security Information
security.description: Security mitigation techniques applied to the executable to protect against exploits.

aslr.name: ASLR
aslr.description: Address Space Layout Randomization. A defense mechanism that randomizes memory locations to prevent memory corruption exploits.

dep.name: DEP
dep.description: Data Execution Prevention. Marks memory locations (like stack/heap) as non-executable to prevent malicious code execution.

cfg.name: CFG
cfg.description: Control Flow Guard. A Microsoft mitigation that verifies indirect call targets to prevent control flow hijacking.

seh.name: SEH
seh.description: Structured Exception Handling. Indicates structured exception handling support and mitigation of control flow hijacking via exception filters (SafeSEH).

certificates.name: Digital Certificates
certificates.description: Digital signatures and certificate chains verifying the publisher and integrity of the executable.

certSubject.name: Subject
certSubject.description: The owner/entity to whom the certificate is issued.

certIssuer.name: Issuer
certIssuer.description: The Certificate Authority (CA) that issued and signed the certificate.

certSerial.name: Serial
certSerial.description: The unique serial number assigned to the certificate by the issuer.

certValidity.name: Validity
certValidity.description: The date range specifying the period when the digital signature is valid.

versionInfo.name: Version Information
versionInfo.description: Descriptive metadata from the resource section, such as product name, file version, company name, and copyright.

tls.name: TLS Callbacks
tls.description: Thread Local Storage callbacks. Functions executed before the program's main Entry Point starts, frequently used in anti-debugging.

tlsCallbacks.name: Callback List
tlsCallbacks.description: The virtual addresses of registered TLS callback functions.

hashes.name: File Hashes
hashes.description: Various cryptographic hashes computed over the executable file for identification.

authentihash.name: Authentihash
authentihash.description: A signature-independent hash computed by excluding the digital signature data and verification structures from the PE hash calculation.
